data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: North Malabar and coastal Karnataka share a world of laterite, coconut, monsoon, temple traditions, spirit worship, seafood, and performance. This route follows that cultural continuum rather than treating the state line as a hard break.

Begin around Kannur when ritual calendars permit Theyyam encounters, continue through Kasaragod and Bekal, then cross into Mangaluru and Udupi. The journey is especially rewarding for travellers interested in living ritual, food, performance, and coastal identity.

items: Light cotton clothing suited to humid coastal weather.

data.title: RITUAL CALENDAR NOTE
data.text: Theyyam and Yakshagana are seasonal and community-rooted traditions. We never guarantee a performance on an arbitrary date; the route is shaped around authentic calendars when possible.

data.title: A Coast Without a Hard Border
paragraphs: The route makes sense when you stop asking where Kerala ends and Karnataka begins. Food, ritual, language, and landscape overlap in ways that are richer than a state boundary suggests.
What you carry home is not one performance or fort, but an understanding of a coastal cultural zone that remains intensely alive.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Can Theyyam be guaranteed on our dates?
paragraphs: No. Authentic Theyyam follows local ritual calendars, so we build around confirmed community events rather than staging substitutes.

items.question: Is this route suitable for vegetarians?
paragraphs: Very much so. Coastal Karnataka and Udupi offer especially strong vegetarian food traditions.

items.question: Can we add beach time?
paragraphs: Yes. We can add a quieter coastal stay without weakening the cultural flow of the route.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
